description: Org-chart boxes, drawn from scratch as box chrome rather than line art. Each is placed as the presentation shape custom:org/<name>; the four variants are role (the everyday name-and-title box), executive (a double border for a leadership or emphasis box), assistant (a box with a left spine, for the assistant who sits on an offset branch beside their manager), and vacancy (a dashed box for a role that is not filled). Coordinates in `elements` are fractions of the node box, so one definition draws at any size; `outline` is solid, double or dashed. Rendering is shared by the web canvas (web/src/model/orgShapes.ts) and the MCP SVG renderer (src/Draughtsman.Mcp/Rendering/SvgRenderer.cs), so the two cannot drift. A role box shows two lines (name and title) by putting a newline in the node's label, which both renderers break into lines.
